srList.sentence: This clinical trial included 63 eyes of 36 patients with primary congenital glaucoma (PCG), eyes were randomized by random allocation computer program into 3 equal groups (21 eyes in each group) eyes in group I were treated with combined trabeculotomy-trabeculectomy (CTT), group II were treated with CTT augmented with mitomycin-C, while eyes in group III were treated with CTT augmented with collagen implant (Ologen).
